scenes.title: What LiquidityX is, and the problem
scenes.text: LiquidityX is a peer-to-peer lending market for MUSD on Mezo. Today, MUSD often sits idle. Borrowers take whatever rate a protocol sets. And pooled lending hides who lends to whom.

scenes.title: Lender: deposit and post a funded offer
scenes.text: A lender deposits 600 MUSD, then posts an offer: 500 at 6 percent, for 30 days. The deposit backs it, so it's always funded.

scenes.title: Borrower: request backed by native BTC
scenes.text: A borrower asks for 1,000 MUSD, at up to 8 percent, and locks 0.02 BTC. The form shows the collateral ratio and the liquidation price.

scenes.title: Matching engine: partial fill, one offer excluded
scenes.text: The matcher takes the cheapest offers first: 400 at 5 percent from another lender, then 500 at 6. That fills 900 of the 1,000. The 9 percent offer is left out, above the borrower's limit. Each fill opens its own loan.

scenes.title: Lender funds the rest at a rate they choose
scenes.text: Our lender funds the last 100 directly, at a rate they pick: 7 percent.

scenes.title: Fixed-rate loan with live interest and liquidation protection
scenes.text: Each loan has a fixed rate, and interest ticks up every second. Below 120 percent collateral, the lender can liquidate. On testnet, the price comes from Mezo's BTC oracle.

scenes.title: Repay in full and withdraw BTC
scenes.text: The borrower repays in full, and takes the BTC back.

scenes.title: Mezo Passport wallet connect
scenes.text: On Mezo, you connect with Mezo Passport: Bitcoin wallets through a Mezo smart account, or Ethereum wallets.

scenes.title: Live on Mezo testnet
scenes.text: LiquidityX is live on Mezo testnet. All seven contracts are verified, and every transaction links to the explorer. An AI-assisted security review found six issues, all fixed.

scenes.title: What's next
scenes.text: Next: rate discovery, liquidation through a DEX, and gasless listings.
